text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Phew! That makes three laps done!
choice_data_list: Good work. That's it for today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Um, could I get two more, please!
choice_data_list: お疲れ。今日はこれでおしまいだね
choice_data_list_en: Good work. That wraps it up for today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling super great right now! I think 
I can get an even better time!
choice_data_list:
Still, with the race coming up, running 
too much might...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not tired at all! Zero miles on this 
engine!"
choice_data_list: でも、レース前だから走り込みすぎは……
choice_data_list_en: Still, the race is right around the corner, so running too much is...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I feel totally fine intuitively too! When 
you're tired, your senses get dull, you 
know."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my head's completely clear right 
now! I don't want to miss this chance!
choice_data_list:
...All right. We stop the moment anything 
feels off.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: ……わかった。違和感が出たらすぐ中止だよ
choice_data_list_en: ...All right. If anything feels off, we stop immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No loose horseshoes here! Yep! All ready 
to go♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This feeling is just like how it felt 
during the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My physical form might still be unrefined, 
but... my "instincts" are flawless!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Her ‘instincts’ are highly reliable. Her 
powerful performances so far are proof 
enough of that.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As far as I can tell, her condition looks 
fine too. On top of that, if her 'feel' is 
spot-on—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, it's 1600m! I'll run an 
even better race than the Oka Sho!
choice_data_list_en: I have high hopes for you, Gran!
